marta: Quick one — proposing a scoped run to tag 'enablement_pending' for accounts with no enablement events and low health (<0.3). Pilot only, want ops sign-off. @dan @sunil

dan: Share the exact filter and what fields we write back. Keep pilot small (<=100) and exclude pilot/enterprise and 'no-contact'.

marta: Dry-run SQL: SELECT account_id, created_at, health_score FROM accounts JOIN cs_health USING(account_id) LEFT JOIN enablement_events USING(account_id) WHERE created_at <= now() - interval '7 days' AND coalesce(enablement_events.count,0)=0 AND health_score < 0.3 AND account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM account_flags WHERE flag IN ('pilot','enterprise','no-contact')) LIMIT 100;

sunil: Approve dry-run with snapshot to cs_health_snapshot_autumn2026 and trace_id in writes. Abort if >1% of pilot rows show health_score delta >0.45 or owner_claim flips. ops-bot: schedule dry_run.

ops-bot: Job queued: enablement_scope_pilot_2850009999 | id=job_2850009999_a | dry_run=true | started_at=2850010005

marta: Kicking off now. I'll post snapshot diff + short summary when finished. Thanks!
